dreams.text: The machine sleeps and sees WAR priced in WINTER, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of FIFA devouring CHRISTMAS, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where LEGISLATIVE forgets it was ever about SUPER.
Far ahead, VENEZUELA and OLYMPICS merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, WAR is law and LARGE is myth.
In the dream, FIFA crosses every chasm at once and finds CHRISTMAS already there.
